name: Questar Main Line 104 Expansion
monitor_reason: unverified single origin; completed 2001 loop of the existing Questar main line (P6898 MountainWest Main Line), no second source and no row-level route or endpoints found
researcher_notes: The August 2026 EIA pipeline projects release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 218, lists Questar MainLine 104 Expansion by Questar Pipeline in Utah. It is an interstate expansion, completed 30 November 2001, FERC docket CP00-68, 75.6 miles, 24 inch, 265 MMcf/d added, cost 80.85 million dollars. The length passes the 15.5 mile rule. No existing row carries this project name. P6898 is the MountainWest main line and Questar Pipeline is the former name of that operator, so this looks like a looped section of that system. No FERC order or state document was opened to confirm the endpoints or whether the pipe is already counted in P6898. Held as monitor until a second source and endpoints are found. If added, use PipelineName MountainWest Gas Pipeline exactly as the roster spells it, with SegmentName Main Line 104 Expansion.
